name: r22_unloaded_cylinders
title: R22 refrigeration machine with unloaded cylinders (exercise)
summary: Teaching exercise: an R22 reciprocating compressor at full displacement (4 cylinders) and at half displacement (2 cylinders), with losses applied before an adiabatic compression. The evaporator and the condenser are effectiveness-NTU exchangers on water. A weight theta mixes the reduced-displacement water outlet with the idle outlet to hold 14 °C.

origin.course: Machines et systèmes thermiques (ULiège), répétition TP 10, exercice 2

verification.summary: compare_solution.py without --ees-units, against the solution stored in MSTH_041123_exercice_2.EES: 101 common variables, 3 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 16. Maximum relative difference 1.66e-03 on t_ev (R22 properties). The 16 CoolSolve-only names are the diagram arrays. Cooling capacity, power and COP of both regimes stay within rtol.
verification.reference: Solution stored in MSTH_041123_exercice_2.EES (101 variables, EES X7.210)
verification.notes: Maximum relative difference over the 101 common variables is 1.66e-03 on t_ev (3.81262 °C EES, 3.80629 °C CoolSolve); the other two above rtol=0.001 are t_su_1 (1.51e-03) and v_ex_1 (1.04e-03). R22 has no constant reference offset of the R134a kind: CoolSolve minus EES is about +8 to +50 J/kg on the vapour enthalpies and about -159 J/kg at the condenser outlet, and about +0.04 to +0.10 J/kg-K on the stored entropies. The vapour residuals largely cancel in the compressor power (relative difference 1.0e-04 at full load, 1.1e-05 at half displacement). They do not cancel in the cooling capacity, which subtracts the liquid enthalpy (5.7e-04 and 5.2e-04). COP follows the capacity residual (4.6e-04 and 5.1e-04). The 30-equation block fails without the shipped .initials (LineSearchFailed at iteration 10) and converges in 12 iterations with them.
